description: Claude Code tool names used in skill text, and how each runtime expresses the same action. Skill text keeps the Claude Code name; an emitter for another runtime rewrites the mention to that runtime's wording, or reports it when the value is "unsupported". Codex and Cursor document capabilities rather than internal tool identifiers, so their wording names the capability (Cursor: the section titles of its Agent tools page).
